description:
We are looking for Cobol Developer in Clinton, OK for 8+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Position: Cobol Developer 
 Location: Clinton, OK 
 Duration: 8+ months 
 Client: Direct Client 
 
 Required Skills: 
 Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years’ experience as a programmer/developer deploying large scale/complex business related applications using the following skills/tools: 
 Experience with COBOL and AS/400 Control Language (CL). 
 Experience with IBM DB2 for AS/400 
 Experience with DB2 query manager and SQL development Kit 
 Experience with the Juvenile On-Line Tracking System (JOLTS) a plus 
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
